question: What is your refund policy?
answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all unopened supplements. If you're not satisfied with an opened product, contact support within 14 days of delivery and we'll issue a refund or store credit on a case-by-case basis.

question: How long does it take to get my refund?
answer: Once we receive and inspect your return, refunds are processed within 3-5 business days. It may take an additional 2-7 business days for the refund to appear on your original payment method, depending on your bank.

question: My order arrived damaged, can I get a replacement?
answer: Yes. If your order arrives damaged or defective, email support@example-supplements.com with a photo of the item within 7 days of delivery and we'll ship a free replacement right away, no return required.

question: I received the wrong product in my order, what should I do?
answer: We're sorry about that! Contact our support team with your order number and a photo of what you received, and we'll send the correct item at no extra cost and provide a prepaid label to return the incorrect one.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Standard shipping is free on all orders over $50. Orders under $50 have a flat shipping fee of $4.99. Expedited 2-day shipping is available at checkout for an additional $9.99.

question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping typically takes 3-5 business days within the continental US. Expedited shipping takes 1-2 business days. International shipping times vary by destination, usually 7-14 business days.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number and a link to track it in real time. You can also view tracking information anytime by logging into your account and visiting Order History.

question: My tracking number isn't updating, what should I do?
answer: Tracking information can take up to 24 hours to update after a label is created. If there's been no movement for more than 3 business days, please contact support and we'll investigate with the carrier on your behalf.

question: Can I cancel or change my order after placing it?
answer: Orders can be changed or canceled within 1 hour of placing them by contacting support immediately. After that window, orders enter fulfillment and can no longer be modified, though you can still request a return once delivered.

question: Are your supplements third-party tested for quality and safety?
answer: Yes, every batch of our supplements is third-party tested for purity, potency, and contaminants. Certificates of Analysis (COAs) for each product are available on request by emailing support@example-supplements.com.
